raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On a PD decode server with `--enable-hisparse`, admitting a request whose sequence fits the device buffer (`seq_len <= device_buffer_size`) preloads its full KV from the host pool into the device buffer. `HiSparseCoordinator._preload_to_device_buffer` does this with a Python loop over every model layer, calling `mem_pool_host.load_to_device_per_layer` once per layer — N separate host→device kernel launches serialized on the scheduler stream ahead of the request's first decode step (78 launches for GLM-5.2). The TODO at the call site (`TODO(hzh0425): Optimize this`) flags this.

The reverse direction already has the batched form: `MLATokenToKVPoolHost.backup_from_device_all_layer` moves all layers in one `transfer_kv_all_layer_mla` / JIT call on the same pool objects and index tensors (used by `admit_request_into_staging`). There is no host→device counterpart.

## Modifications

Four stacked commits, Python-only, no kernel changes.

- `pool_host/base.py`: add a concrete `load_to_device_all_layer(device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend)` default on `HostKVCache` that loops per-layer. Concrete, not abstract, so the existing subclasses are unaffected; subclasses with a batched kernel override it.
- `pool_host/mla.py`: `MLATokenToKVPoolHost.load_to_device_all_layer`, a mirror of `backup_from_device_all_layer` with src/dst swapped for H2D:
  - `layer_first` + `kernel`: one `transfer_kv_all_layer_mla` (or JIT `transfer_hicache_all_layer_mla`) moves all layers host→device. `dst=device_data_ptrs`, `src=self.data_ptrs`; dst stride `device_row_stride_bytes`, src stride `token_stride_size` (the reverse of backup's stride assignment).
  - `layer_first` + `direct`: symmetric `transfer_kv_direct` swap.
  - `kernel_ascend`: explicit `TransferDirection.H2D` (the dim-exchange kernel takes direction as an argument).
  - `page_first` / `page_first_direct`: the all-layer kernels are directionally baked layer-first→page-first (device→host for backup) and no page-first→layer-first all-layer counterpart exists, so fall back to the per-layer H2D loop (`transfer_kv_per_layer_mla_pf_lf`). No `lf_pf` or staged write-back kernel is called for H2D.
  - Layer-sharded (CP) device pools: per-layer fallback over `_target_layer_indices` + MTP draft slots, matching `backup_from_device_all_layer`.
  - The batched launch covers all host pool rows — target layers plus MTP draft layers — the same coverage `backup_from_device_all_layer` already has. The old per-layer preload loop moved target layers only.
- `pool_host/mla.py` (fix): split `load_to_device_per_layer` into a public wrapper (ownership check + DCP translation) and a private `_load_to_device_per_layer` worker, mirroring `_backup_from_device_per_layer`. The all-layer fallback loops call the private worker, avoiding a double `maybe_dcp_kernel_indices` translation when `dcp_size > 1`.
- `managers/hisparse_coordinator.py`: `_preload_to_device_buffer` calls `load_to_device_all_layer` once. The M3/MiMaha branch keeps its per-layer loop (`HiSparseMHATokenToKVPoolHost` has no batched override; it inherits the base-class default, which is itself the per-layer loop).

## Accuracy Tests

Pure data movement: no kernel, model-forward, or sampling change. One `load_to_device_all_layer` call produces device-pool state byte-identical to N× `load_to_device_per_layer` (verified with an ad-hoc equivalence harness on the `direct` backend; dispatch count confirmed the single all-layer kernel).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- The win is kernel-launch count on the request-admission path, not steady-state throughput. Admission preload goes from N launches (one per layer) to 1 for the `layer_first` host layout (measured 4→1 on a 4-layer test pool; structural N→1, e.g. 78→1 for GLM-5.2, since the call is layer-count-agnostic).
- Scope: the batched path requires `--hicache-mem-layout layer_first`. The default `page_first` layout takes the per-layer fallback — correct, but no launch-count reduction there.
- E2E (1P1D PD pair + router, HiSparse decode, `layer_first`, 2-layer DSA test model): short-sequence requests admitted cleanly; instrumentation confirmed the preload took the batched `layer_first / kernel / non-sharded` branch once per admission (the `transfer_kv_all_layer_mla` path, not the fallback).
- Unit (branch-matched tree): `test_hisparse_unit.py` — 9 passed, 2 skipped.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style).

         """

+    def load_to_device_all_layer(
+        self, device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend
+    ) -> None:
+        """Load KV data from the host memory pool to the device memory pool for all layers.
+
+        Default: per-layer loop. Subclasses with a batched all-layer kernel
+        (e.g. MLATokenToKVPoolHost) override to avoid N kernel launches.
+        """
+        for layer_id in range(device_pool.layer_num):
+            self.load_to_device_per_layer(
+                device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, layer_id, io_backend
+            )
+
     @abc.abstractmethod
     def backup_from_device_all_layer(
         self, device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend

@@ -687,6 +687,28 @@ def load_to_device_per_layer(
         device_indices = maybe_dcp_kernel_indices(
             device_indices, self.dcp_size, self.dcp_rank
         )
+        self._load_to_device_per_layer(
+            device_pool,
+            host_indices,
+            device_indices,
+            layer_id,
+            io_backend,
+            is_draft=is_draft,

+
+    def _load_to_device_per_layer(
+        self,
+        device_pool,
+        host_indices,
+        device_indices,
+        layer_id,
+        io_backend,
+        *,
+        is_draft: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        assert not self._is_dummy, "load on a dummy (non-src MLA) host pool"
+        # Indices arrive already translated by load_to_device_all_layer or the
+        # public load_to_device_per_layer wrapper; do NOT re-translate here.
         # Draft transfer IDs follow all target device layers, while host rows
         # follow only this rank's target layers.
         host_layer_id = self._host_layer_by_controller[layer_id]
@@ -879,6 +901,119 @@ def _backup_from_device_per_layer(
                     f"layer_first layout, got {self.layout}"
                 )
 
+    def load_to_device_all_layer(
+        self, device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend
+    ) -> None:
+        assert not self._is_dummy, "load on a dummy (non-src MLA) host pool"
+        host_indices = maybe_dcp_kernel_indices(
+            host_indices, self.dcp_size, self.dcp_rank
+        )
+        device_indices = maybe_dcp_kernel_indices(
+            device_indices, self.dcp_size, self.dcp_rank
+        )
+        if self._layer_shard_enabled:
+            for layer_id in self._target_layer_indices:
+                self._load_to_device_per_layer(
+                    device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, layer_id, io_backend
+                )
+            for draft_layer_id in range(self._draft_layer_num):
+                self._load_to_device_per_layer(
+                    device_pool,
+                    host_indices,
+                    device_indices,
+                    self._device_layer_num + draft_layer_id,
+                    io_backend,
+                    is_draft=True,
+                )
+            return
+
+        if io_backend == "kernel_ascend":
+            device_data_ptrs, device_kv_buffers = None, None
+        else:
+            device_data_ptrs = self.device_data_ptrs
+            device_kv_buffers = self.device_kv_buffers
+
+        if io_backend == "kernel":
+            if self.layout == "layer_first":
+                if self.can_use_jit:
+                    jit_transfer_hicache_all_layer_mla(
+                        page_size=self.page_size,
+                        ptr_dst=device_data_ptrs,
+                        indices_dst=device_indices,
+                        ptr_src=self.data_ptrs,
+                        indices_src=host_indices,
+                        cache_dst_stride_bytes=self.device_row_stride_bytes,
+                        cache_src_stride_bytes=self.token_stride_size,
+                        element_size=self.kv_cache_dim * self.dtype.itemsize,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self._require_packed_device_rows("transfer_kv_all_layer_mla")
+                    transfer_kv_all_layer_mla(
+                        src_layers=self.data_ptrs,
+                        dst_layers=device_data_ptrs,
+                        src_indices=host_indices,
+                        dst_indices=device_indices,
+                        item_size=self.token_stride_size,
+                        num_layers=self.layer_num,
+                    )
+            elif self.layout == "page_first":
+                # The all-layer kernels are directionally baked lf->pf (device->host
+                # for backup); no pf->lf all-layer counterpart exists. Fall back to
+                # the per-layer H2D loop (transfer_kv_per_layer_mla_pf_lf).
+                for layer_id in self._target_layer_indices:
+                    self._load_to_device_per_layer(
+                        device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, layer_id, io_backend
+                    )
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported layout: {self.layout}")
+        elif io_backend == "direct":
+            if self.layout == "layer_first":
+                transfer_kv_direct(
+                    src_layers=self.data_refs,
+                    dst_layers=device_kv_buffers,
+                    src_indices=host_indices,
+                    dst_indices=device_indices,
+                    page_size=self.page_size,
+                )
+            elif self.layout == "page_first_direct":
+                # transfer_kv_all_layer_direct_lf_pf is lf->pf (device->host) only;
+                # no all-layer pf->lf counterpart. Per-layer H2D fallback.
+                for layer_id in self._target_layer_indices:
+                    self._load_to_device_per_layer(
+                        device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, layer_id, io_backend
+                    )
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported layout: {self.layout}")
+        elif io_backend == "kernel_ascend":
+            native = self._native_infos[0].native_buffers()
+            if self.layout == "page_first_kv_split":
+                if _is_npu and ascendc_io_enabled():
+                    self._transfer_ascendc_sparse_copy(
+                        native,
+                        host_indices,
+                        device_indices,
+                        TransferDirection.H2D,
+                    )
+                    return
+                transfer_kv_dim_exchange(
+                    device_indices=device_indices,
+                    host_indices=host_indices,
+                    device_k=native.k,
+                    host_k=self.k_buffer,
+                    device_v=native.v,
+                    host_v=self.v_buffer,
+                    device_index_k=native.index_k,
+                    host_index_k=self.index_k_buffer,
+                    device_index_k_scale=native.index_scales,
+                    host_index_k_scale=self.index_k_scale_buffer,
+                    page_size=self.page_size,
+                    direction=TransferDirection.H2D,
+                )
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported layout: {self.layout}")
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported IO backend: {io_backend}")
+
     def backup_from_device_all_layer(
         self, device_pool, host_indices, device_indices, io_backend
     ):
